notes.title: Demo version v0.0.17 update notes
notes.notes:
[h2]v0.0.17[/h2]
[h3]BUG FIXES[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed localization issues in skill training displays.
[*] Fixed display problems in hover tooltips for Professions items.
[*] Fixed the Settings panel incorrectly showing a “Clear Data” in game.
[*] Fixed localization for the “Mastered” status on skill books.
[/list]

[h3]IMPROVEMENTS & ADJUSTMENTS[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved wording for Intellect requirements on item tooltips.
[*] Added contextual tips across the Attributes panel.
[*] Increased the amount of random resources dropped after battles.
[*] Reduced the difficulty of the “Windgrove Ridge” quest.
[*] Improved the Quest Tracker UI—mouse wheel scrolling is now supported.
[*] Polished the UI effects for the top-left buttons on the main panel.
[*] Refined the “Quest Details” presentation in the Quest panel.
[*] Players can now equip up to three Principles simultaneously.
[*] All Origins now start with one Principle; the starting Principle is locked and cannot be replaced.
[*] For skill that require aptitude below a threshold, lower-aptitude characters now train them faster.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo version v0.0.16 update notes
notes.notes:
[h2]v0.0.16[/h2]
[h3]BUG FIXES[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where clicking too quickly on the battle results screen could cause an error.
[*] Fixed several quests that were missing quest descriptions.
[/list]

[h3]IMPROVEMENTS & ADJUSTMENTS[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reworked Ultimate: you can now manually trigger it when the qi bar is full.
[*] Improved localization layout for martial skill effect text.
[*] Lowered the difficulty of the “Disciples of the Zen Gate” event.
[*] Each battle victory now drops money.
[*] Chongwu Hall quest rewards are now a choice between a fixed reward and a random reward.
[*] Added two new Special Attacks: 
[*] ①Reversal — increases damage based on total damage taken outside the current turn; 
[*] ②Demonbane — deals extra damage when the user is under a negative status.
[*] Polished sect martial traits. The following sect traits are now enabled: 
[*] Shaolin — Demonbane; Wudang — Reversal; Starreach Pavilion — Backstab, Exploit; Divine Sword Manor — Absolute Hit; Wuwei Sect — Penetrate; Heavenly Sound Sect — Internal Injury, Severe.
[/list]

notes.title: 【Game Feature : Imprint Characters】
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44786950/367ca532500940bdfbdbdae3740b5704540ca55f.png[/img]

Have you ever met an NPC in a game—so powerful, so charismatic, or so tragic—that you thought, "What if I could become them?"

In [b]Wuxia Saga: Ten Thousand Paths[/b], that thought becomes a reality. If you manage to defeat a particular NPC and pay a certain price, you can imprint their soul, preserving their stats, traits, and martial skills. In your next playthrough, you’ll be able to start the game as that very character, living their journey—or rewriting it.

Each imprint unlocks a new path. Each restart is a new destiny waiting to unfold.

notes.title: 【Game Feature : Arts Duel(Card Play)】
notes.notes:
[h2]There Is More Than Just Battles[/h2]

In Wuxia Saga: Ten Thousand Paths, beyond the usual attack, defense attributes, there are also dozens of "Artistic Skills" such as music, chess, calligraphy, painting, and more. These skills not only influence martial arts but also play unique roles throughout the game—one of which is the Dueling Arts System introduced today.

Apart from martial duels, players can challenge others using different Artistic Skills. These duels allow players to enhance their skills, build relationships with characters, obtain special items, and even unlock hidden storylines.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44786950/34208881a0efdfb81dc019235c2198fe3c87df51.gif[/img]

Each duel is filled with strategy and unpredictability. The system is easy to learn but offers deep tactical possibilities. As you explore the world, you can collect various cards and craft unique strategies to outmatch your opponents!

notes.title: [Game Feature : Hunting]
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! I'm Rafiki, the developer of the Ever-Changing JiangHu. I'll be periodically updating you with some game feature introductions to help interested players get a better understanding of the game.

In an open-world game, having places worth exploring is crucial. Players can mine, chop wood, and hunt in various locations within the game to discover and collect a wide array of unique items.

To create a sensible system, I've followed Mr. Jin Yong's approach of drawing from traditional culture and historical knowledge to enhance the immersion of the storyline. I've consulted dozens of ancient texts and research papers, either directly using or adapting them to add nearly a hundred types of wood, minerals, and game into the game. This not only enriches the game content but also maintains the crucial sense of immersion that role-playing games require.

This time, I'm introducing the hunting system. Players can obtain materials through hunting, and during the process, various events may be triggered, such as encountering aggressive creatures and engaging in combat, like tigers and venomous snakes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44786950/97725af951fcf38f00a9932d7ff8f26b5015c350.png[/img]

To increase playability, I've added some gameplay elements around this system. For example, players can learn animal skills through certain methods, or even tame animals to make them teammates. After defeating rare and exotic beasts, players might find divine martial arts manuals in their bellies, a classic plot that can happen in the Ever-Changing JiangHu.

When developing, I place great emphasis on the diversity of gameplay. For example, with the collection system mentioned this time, I don't want it to be just a boring, isolated system for players to obtain resources. Therefore, I've integrated this system into the game from various aspects, striving to make it more fun and a more integral part of the game world.

Finally, I'm working overtime to create the demo version of the game. Since it's still a one-person project, the progress might be slower, so I hope you can understand.

If you're interested in the game, please wishlist it; thanks!
